retraction.reason: Re-read on 24 September under A14(6) against the bar that replaced M44b’s: a record earns its place by carrying at least one honest edge to anything already in the atlas, and nothing is written in order to keep one. The corpus is 859 active events across all five lanes, not the Portuguese core M44b judged this against. Asia is in the atlas now, 122 active events, which is what M44b said was missing. The article, at revision 1375466345, puts the Indian Peace Keeping Force at the centre of the war’s middle years, and the atlas holds no Indian record it touches: india-pakistan-war-of-1971 is fourteen years earlier and the article draws no line to it. Twenty-six years of war still reaching nothing, and now for want of the IPKF rather than for want of Lisbon.

title: Sri Lankan civil war
summary: Wikidata item Q213394, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "armed conflict in Sri Lanka (1983–2009) between the government and the separatist organization Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
